item.title: FYI: News Briefs in HVAC - March 2, 2026
item.description: For your information news briefs from a wide variety of categories within the HVAC industry. Price increases, mergers and acquisitions, award winners, and more are highlighted here each issue.

item.title: Study: 31% of HVAC Contractors Expect Their Distributor to Have Key Parts Available Same-Day
item.description: Two contractors, while they generally agreed with the way priorities were ranked in a survey of their peers, had their own takes on what they want to see from distributors.

item.title: Tariffs and Supply Woes Drive Metal Prices Higher, Squeezing U.S. Construction Industry
item.description: Contractors face rising input prices and shrinking project pipelines, with industry leaders warning that uncertainty over trade policy and federal funding could stall growth.

item.title: VTS American Announces 15% Price Reduction on Its Largest Air Handling Platforms
item.description: This strategic adjustment applies specifically to these high-capacity units engineered for large-scale and mission-critical applications.

item.title: Is Space the Final Frontier for Data Centers?
item.description: With residential HVAC slumping, data centers are driving growth — but new chip designs, local resistance, and even space-based alternatives raise questions about whether that boom will last.

item.title: How Axial-Flow Fan Packages Are Redefining HVAC Performance
item.description: Axial-flow fan packages with high-efficiency motors and VSDs are transforming HVAC performance, offering significantly greater energy savings, reliability, and sustainability than traditional EC fans.

item.title: Breathing New Life into America’s Schools: The Fight for Cleaner Indoor Air
item.description: A new coalition is working to upgrade HVAC systems and building materials in America’s schools, aiming to improve student health, equity, and learning by transforming indoor air quality.

item.title: From Perk to Expectation: How Financing Is Reshaping HVACR Sales
item.description: 37% of HVAC contractors offer financing options on every job.

item.title: How Digital Tools Are Transforming HVAC, Sheet Metal Contracting
item.description: Sheet metal contractors are rewriting the rules, as companies like Hermanson and shops around the world use real-time digital workflows, and automation to make fabrication faster and more collaborative.

item.title: EGIA Foundation and the GRIT Foundation Partner to Expand HVAC Scholarship Program
item.description: At its core, this partnership is about creating real pathways into stable, meaningful, in-demand careers, and giving people a chance to see themselves in a future where they can thrive.
